jobs.desc: About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients. Position SummaryÂ The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration Commissioning (SI C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â Key ResponsibilitiesÂ On-Site DeliveryÂ Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI C team.Â Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â Remote / Office DeliveryÂ Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â Project Configuration DeploymentÂ Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack Hold).Â Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â Scope IndependenceÂ This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â Preferred QualificationsÂ Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â What we Offer: Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Health Care Concierge Service 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax Roth) Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability Long-Term Disability Voluntary Life AD D Insurance Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness Hospital Indemnity Insurance Pet Insurance Milk Stork Program Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick 10 Holidays) Training Development Why KPI Solutions? jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.desc: About Foundation Health Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy. We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other. The Role You'd be one of the first QA hires in the UK, working alongside our UK QA Lead to build how we do quality here: frameworks, standards and process, with no legacy test debt to dig out of. Everybody here is hands-on, and that's what this role is: in the detail, every day. Before anything we build reaches a pharmacist's queue in the US, someone has to decide it's ready. That's you. If you take pride in what ships, and you'll say "this isn't ready" even when everyone wants it out the door, you'll fit right in. We've built an AI operating system for pharmacies, tackling the operational infrastructure behind things like paperwork and care coordination. It's in production with enterprise health systems across the US, and we're working directly with one of the biggest names in pharmacy. What you'll actually do Help shape our UK QA practice with the QA Lead: frameworks, standards and how we work day to day Write automated tests in Playwright and test our APIs with Postman, across a serverless stack of Node.js, TypeScript, SvelteKit and GCP Test AI-powered features in production, including agentic workflows and LLM outputs, and help build the evals that tell us whether they're behaving Do proper manual testing, regression and UAT when a release needs it, and know when that beats automation Work closely with engineers to catch issues early, so moving fast never comes at the cost of the product Who you are You've got the experience . You have 3+ years in QA or software testing, with solid work on web apps and APIs. You're strong with Playwright . You also have a good instinct for when to automate and when to test by hand. You know what's at stake . You've worked on enterprise products, so you understand what happens when something breaks. You actually use AI . It's already part of how you work, or you've tested AI-powered products and know why it's a different problem. You care about the outcome . Quality matters to you as a result, not as a process to tick off. The setup Hybrid, Manchester city centre, 1-2 days a week in the office. When you're working out what "correct" even means for an AI system, a whiteboard and the right three people in a room beat a Slack thread every time. Not local? We offer relocation support for the right person. We're Series A, there's early equity, and the work genuinely changes how people get their medication. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

About the Role: As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend on Camunda’s Distributed Systems team, you’ll help build and evolve the durable, highly available, horizontally scalable streaming platform that underpins Camunda 8’s Orchestration Cluster and powers mission‑critical processes for customers around the world. As part of the Distributed Systems team, you will work on technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as expanding on our multi-Raft implementation, our SWIM-based cluster membership algorithm, or high performance network and disk I/O pipelines. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs. Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale What You Will Do: Design, build, and maintain backend services for the distributed streaming platform that powers the foundation for Camunda 8’s orchestration capabilities, ensuring durability, high availability, and horizontal scalability. Lead medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end‑to‑end : partner with Product to translate business problems into technical requirements, write solution designs, draft and maintain project plans, and drive timely, high‑quality delivery. Help mature our disaster recovery and resilience story , including implementing and evolving an online backup/restore API and contributing to improved multi‑region and multi‑tenant capabilities for our cloud offering. Design and implement developer and operator tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate a complex distributed system in production environments. Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel. Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations , partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our product and platform. What You Will Bring to the Role: Must Haves: 7+ years of professional experience as a software engineer , with a strong focus on backend systems and/or distributed systems. Proven experience leading medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (roughly 3+ months), breaking down ambiguous problems, writing clear solution designs and project plans, coordinating with multiple teams, and driving predictable delivery. Hands‑on experience building and maintaining highly concurrent, data‑intensive software , with a deep understanding of low‑level network and disk I/O (for example, throughput, latency, backpressure, batching, and failure modes). Demonstrated ability to work autonomously and navigate ambiguity – you are comfortable taking on problems you haven’t solved before, breaking them down into concrete steps, and driving them to completion with minimal supervision. Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote‑first environment : you tailor explanations to your audience, translate business requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and help teams reach clear, decisive outcomes with minimal churn. Nice to Haves: Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software. Experience with distributed systems algorithms or protocols such as Raft, Paxos, SWIM, and/or CRDTs. Strong familiarity with the observability pillars (logging, metrics, tracing) and how to integrate observability into the development and incident lifecycle, ideally including experience with L3 support and on‑call. Deep knowledge of the Java Virtual Machine , especially its memory model and performance characteristics in highly concurrent, data‑intensive workloads.
